name: jewelry-platform
description: 珠宝产品管理平台 - 高级科幻风格全栈网站

scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:client
scripts.test: npm run test:contracts && npm run test:public-assets
scripts.test:content-templates: npm run contracts:check && node scripts/verify-content-template-contract.mjs && node scripts/verify-content-template-skeletons.mjs && node scripts/verify-content-template-image-specs.mjs && node scripts/verify-inspector-schema.mjs
scripts.test:trade: npm run test:trade-state && npm run test:trade-concurrency && npm run test:trade-contract
scripts.db:migrate: cd server && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
